issues.body: The round-2 policy blocker is only partially resolved. Immediately before the newly added DONE note, the changed companion record still states fixed timings for conformance ratchets, container-scan, and CodeQL (44–76 s, 3.6 m, and 3.8 m). Because this PR updates and ratifies that conclusion, leaving those figures in its durable prose preserves the same prohibited hard-coded performance evidence at the same severity.
issues.fix_hint: Remove the three literal timings from the companion record and keep the conclusion qualitative (for example: short parallel legs that are never the pole; parallel non-critical-path scan; security gate with negligible profile benefit). Point readers to the cited profile tables or run logs for measurements.
issues.title: Companion record still embeds hard-coded performance timings

verdict.summary: Round 3 is stagnant. The new Appendix A text has removed the previously embedded durations and projected minute range, but the companion changed research record still retains fixed per-leg performance timings (44–76 s, 3.6 m, and 3.8 m) in the durable lever-4 conclusion immediately above the newly added completion note. This is the same major repository-policy violation identified in round 2: hard-coded performance numbers are forbidden, and dated work-box/CI timings must remain in linked generated/profile evidence rather than durable prose. The soundness memo otherwise presents its ALLGREEN premise, induction, and residual remote-setting risk clearly, but approval remains blocked until the remaining literal timings are removed.
